_comment: What the aggregator considers newsworthy for Proof & Perspective.
A phrase in the headline counts double. Scores are relative, not absolute —
the number only decides the order you read things in, and you decide what
goes in the issue. Edit freely: this file is the whole editorial filter.
Weights track the brand promise. Money, supply and verifiable facts score
high because 'Drink Smarter. Ignore the Noise.' is a claim about price and
value; celebrity launches and cocktail content score low or are muted
require  an item must contain at least one of these or it is dropped as
off-topic. This is what keeps tequila, watches and travel out of
weights  negative numbers are the useful half. Tasting reviews sink to
the bottom of the run rather than being muted, because now and
then one carries a price or a proof change worth a bullet.
